purpose: Disable the now-dormant Cloudflare employee compatibility Bridge without changing Worker code or any unrelated binding.
safety: Create a settings-only version inheriting every non-target binding from the exact active version.

Require the new version script etag to equal the pre-version script etag.
Require binding names/counts/types and D1 binding to remain intact.
Deploy only the validated version at 100 percent.
Rollback automatically to the exact pre-version on any post-deploy failure.
Verify the disabled Bridge route fails closed before authentication or upstream forwarding.
Do not change D1 controls, frontend, Accounting, EasyStore, or Apps Script.
